target.title: fix(browser): honor evaluate timeout for existing sessions
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #103137.

`openclaw browser evaluate --timeout-ms 60000` could not apply the requested budget for Chrome MCP existing-session profiles. The CLI already placed `timeoutMs` on the evaluate action, and the Chrome MCP adapter already forwards operation budgets to `client.callTool(..., { timeout })`, but the existing-session `/act` route rejected evaluate requests that included `timeoutMs` before they reached Chrome MCP.

## Why This Change Was Made

This keeps the scope limited to the evaluate path:

- allow existing-session `act:evaluate` requests to carry `timeoutMs` through the `/act` route
- keep the existing timeout rejection for type/hover/scroll/drag/select/fill actions unchanged
- update browser tool guidance so agents no longer omit `timeoutMs` for existing-session evaluate
- inject the configured browser action timeout for existing-session evaluate actions, so proxy routing gets an outer request budget with slack

## User Impact

For the reported command shape, the requested `60000ms` evaluate budget is now forwarded to Chrome MCP instead of being blocked before execution. Default agent-tool evaluate calls on existing-session profiles also get the configured action timeout, avoiding an unbudgeted proxy hop.

## Evidence

Behavior proof from focused regression tests:

- Before this patch, `body: { kind: "evaluate", timeoutMs: 60000 }` on an existing-session profile hit the unsupported-operation guard and never called `evaluateChromeMcpScript`.
- After this patch, the regression test returns HTTP 200 and asserts `evaluateChromeMcpScript` receives `timeoutMs: 60000`.
- A second regression test asserts the browser tool injects configured `actionTimeoutMs: 45000` for existing-session evaluate actions.

Validation run on Node 24 after rebasing on latest `upstream/main` (`b0e77bbe72c`):

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run \
  extensions/browser/src/browser/routes/agent.act.existing-session-navigation-guard.test.ts \
  extensions/browser/src/browser/routes/agent.existing-session.test.ts \
  extensions/browser/src/browser-tool.test.ts \
  extensions/browser/src/cli/browser-cli-actions-input/register.form-wait-eval.test.ts
# 4 files, 128 tests passed

OPENCLAW_CHECK_CHANGED_REMOTE_CHILD=1 corepack pnpm check:changed --base upstream/main --timed
# passed: extension typecheck, extension test typecheck, lint changed files, import cycles, runtime sidecar loader guard, dependency/patch guards

corepack pnpm build
# passed; total 201.7s, slowest tsdown 194.1s
```

## AI-assisted

I used an AI coding assistant to inspect the issue path, implement the focused patch, and run the validation commands above. I reviewed the resulting diff and tests before opening this PR.

Signed-off-by: Ho Lim <subhoya@gmail.com>
